Goerli shadow fork 4 configs are out now: https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/goerli-shadow-fork-4

The shadow fork is set to occur 8:30AM on Tuesday (19th April)(So we can observe things together after TTD in person). The corresponding beaconchain launches tomorrow. 

Tooling links can be found here: 
https://beaconchain.goerlishadowfork4.ethdevops.io
https://explorer.goerlishadowfork4.ethdevops.io
https://ethstats.goerlishadowfork4.ethdevops.io

(There should be a total of 20 combinations taking part in this shadow fork, mainnet validator split - so some combinations have no validators but will be following the chain pre-post TTD).
